probes.name: Call-Boundary Batching (16× Amortization)
probes.finding: Single kernel call (0.020 ms) already dwarfs JS↔Wasm trampoline overhead (~ns), so call batching is neutral (1.00×).

probes.name: 4× Dispatch Unrolling & ILP
probes.finding: CPU branch predictor already predicts the outer dispatch loop (0.99×); inner-loop unrolling lives inside the -funroll-loops probe above.

probes.name: Pinned Instance & Arena Reuse vs Per-Task Instantiate
probes.finding: Reusing the pre-instantiated WebAssembly.Instance and linear memory arena avoids 0.010 ms of per-task instance/page initialization (1.45× faster).

probes.name: JIT / Liftoff→TurboFan Warmup Tier-Up
probes.finding: Warm tier-up reduced execution time from 0.068 ms to 0.042 ms (1.61×).

workloads.verdict: Isolated C -O3 -msimd128 -funroll-loops emitted 66 v128 SIMD instructions (1.80× vs Track A scalar) and matched oracle 0xc040d82f. Caching WebAssembly.Instance & linear memory across tasks is 1.45× faster than instantiating per task (0.022 ms vs 0.032 ms).
